recognize_zh: 上下兩個間期核分別使用 MYC 與 BCL2 雙色斷裂分離（break-apart）探針：各有一組紅綠融合訊號（正常等位基因）加上一個分開的紅點與綠點（斷裂），代表 MYC 與 BCL2 同時重排，即雙打擊淋巴瘤。
features: Interphase FISH with MYC dual-color break-apart probe (5' MYC red, 3' MYC green)
MYC nucleus: one fused red-green signal plus one separate red and one separate green signal, indicating MYC rearrangement
Interphase FISH with BCL2 dual-color break-apart probe (5' BCL2 red, 3' BCL2 green)
BCL2 nucleus: one fused signal plus split red and green signals, indicating BCL2 rearrangement
describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization was performed with dual-color break-apart probes for MYC (5' red, 3' green) and BCL2 (5' red, 3' green). In each representative nucleus, one allele shows a fused or closely apposed red-green signal (intact locus), while the other allele shows widely separated red and green signals, indicating a break within the locus. These results demonstrate concurrent rearrangements of MYC and BCL2. Break-apart probes do not identify the partner gene. In a large B-cell lymphoma, this is consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit).
